summary: Ecopetrol S.A., Colombia's state-controlled integrated energy major, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a board communication dated September 14, 2026, in which director Hildebrando Vélez Galeano stated his intention to resign from the Board of Directors effective September 15, 2026. The company thanked him for leadership on environmental matters and community relations. The filing states the Board will continue to validly deliberate with its remaining members, implying no quorum issue. No replacement, interim appointment, or committee succession was named; no compensation, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock appears. Watch governance continuity and any further director turnover.
